+def thread_snapshot(pid, expected_group):
+    before = time.monotonic_ns()
+    observed, vanished = [], []
+    tids = sorted(int(p.name) for p in Path(f'/proc/{pid}/task').iterdir())
+    for tid in tids:
+        try:
+            group = q.bridge.cgroup(tid)
+            affinity = os.sched_getaffinity(tid)
+            require(group == expected_group and affinity == {2},
+                f'Live service thread cgroup/CPU affinity mismatch: tid={tid}, '
+                f'cgroup={group}, expected_cgroup={expected_group}, '
+                f'affinity={sorted(affinity)}, expected_affinity=[2]')
+            observed.append(tid)
+        except (FileNotFoundError, ProcessLookupError):
+            vanished.append(tid)
+    require(pid in observed, 'Main service thread unavailable during snapshot')
+    return dict(before_ns=before, after_ns=time.monotonic_ns(), tids=observed,
+                vanished_during_enumeration=vanished, cgroup=str(expected_group), affinity=[2])
